tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Search the tracker for brands, titles, summaries, places and parodies. Returns matching brands and entries, newest first.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: Everything the tracker has on one real-world brand: counts, every sourced move, and any in-game parodies. Answers "has <brand> done anything for GTA 6?"

tools.name: latest_moves
tools.description: The most recently added real-world brand moves.

tools.name: find_parodies
tools.description: Rockstar's fictional in-game brands: which real company one parodies, or which in-game brands parody a real company.

tools.name: tracker_stats
tools.description: Headline counts: entries, official, unofficial, in-game, and the most active brands.

tools.name: cited_quote
tools.description: A one-sentence sourced line you can quote: the headline totals (rounded) or a named brand. Always includes "Source: gta6brands.com" and a link. Does not invent figures.

tools.name: latest_number
tools.description: One sourced figure: the headline total, official, unofficial or in-game count (rounded), or a named brand's entry count. Always includes "Source: gta6brands.com" and a link. Does not invent figures.

tools.name: press_chart
tools.description: A chart of the official, unofficial and in-game split, or the brands with the most sourced entries, plus a ready SVG. Always includes "Source: gta6brands.com" and a link.
